dicej opened PR #14445 from dicej:empty-path-with-query to bytecodealliance:main:

The behavior of http::uri::PathAndQuery::from_str("") changed in v1.4.1 of the http crate, and although Wasmtime itself has not yet upgraded from the older version it currently depends on, embedders may end up with a newer version.

Specifically, the old behavior was to implicitly convert the empty string to a slash, whereas the new behavior is to return an error.

According to https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3986#section-3.3, an empty string should be acceptable, so this commit restores the old behavior by doing the conversion before passing the result to PathAndQuery::from_str. That ensures consistent behavior regardless of which version of the http crate the embedder ends up depending on.
